# Official Meshtastic protobuf/CLI package. We only use the compiled
# protobuf messages (meshtastic.protobuf.*) for decoding MQTT traffic, but
# depending on the upstream package -- rather than vendoring copies of the
# .proto-generated files -- means protocol changes are picked up with a
# routine version bump instead of a manual re-sync.
